parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the External RFI

id.description: Unique string identifier for this external RFI.

position.description: Sequential position number of this external RFI within the project.

full_position.description: Position number prefixed with the project identifier (e.g. `PRE-1`).

subject.description: Subject line of the external RFI.

revision.description: Revision counter. Increments each time a new revision of this RFI is created.

current_revision.description: When `true`, this record represents the most recent revision of the RFI.

has_revisions.description: When `true`, this RFI has one or more prior revisions.

private.description: When `true`, this RFI is only visible to users with admin-level access.

responsible_contractor.description: Vendor designated as the party responsible for responding to this RFI.

id.description: Unique string identifier of the vendor.

name.description: Display name of the responsible contractor vendor.

last_updated_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this external RFI, in ISO 8601 format.

updates_paused.description: When `true`, the upstream RFI was updated while it was open and this connection syncs closed RFIs only, so this copy was left unchanged. `false` when updates are current, or when Sync on Open is on...

sync_status.description: Synchronization state between the local and upstream RFI.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the external RFI. Recycled variants (e.g. `open_recycled`) appear when the RFI has been moved to the recycle bin.

due_date.description: Date by which a response is expected, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. Null if no due date is set.

created_by.description: Contact who originally created this external RFI.

id.description: Unique string identifier of the contact record.

login_information_id.description: Deprecated. This field is not returned by the API.

name.description: Full display name of the contact.

rfi_manager.description: Contact assigned as manager of this external RFI.

id.description: Unique string identifier of the contact record.

login_information_id.description: Deprecated. This field is not returned by the API.

name.description: Full display name of the contact.

received_from.description: Contact who submitted or originated this external RFI.

id.description: Unique string identifier of the contact record.

login_information_id.description: Deprecated. This field is not returned by the API.

name.description: Full display name of the contact.

download_all_attachments_url.description: URL to download a zip archive of all attachments on this external RFI.

initiated_at.description: Timestamp when this external RFI was opened/initiated, in ISO 8601 format. Null for draft external RFIs.

time_resolved.description: Timestamp when this external RFI was closed, in ISO 8601 format. Null if still open.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this external RFI record was created, in ISO 8601 format.

question.description: Body of the RFI question. May contain HTML markup.

attachments.description: Files attached directly to this external RFI (not to its responses).

cover_sheet.description: Cover sheet document for this external RFI, if one has been attached.

responses.description: Official and informal responses to this external RFI.

project_connection.description: Details of the upstream project this external RFI is connected to. Null if not connected.

upstream_project_name.description: Display name of the upstream (GC) project.

upstream_company_name.description: Display name of the company that owns the upstream project.

upstream_project_id.description: Unique string identifier of the upstream project.

upstream_company_id.description: Unique string identifier of the company that owns the upstream project.

sync_on_open_enabled.description: When `true`, this connection syncs open RFIs from the upstream project in addition to closed ones. `false` when the connection syncs closed RFIs only, or the setting cannot be determined.

connection_status.description: Whether this external RFI is actively connected to a local RFI. One of `connected` or `disconnected`.

download_external_rfi_and_responses_atta.description: URL to download a zip of all attachments across this external RFI and its responses. Null if no attachments exist.

origin_rfi_id.description: ID of the originating local RFI that was exported to create this external RFI. Null if there is no originating RFI.

origin_project_id.description: ID of the upstream project that the originating RFI belongs to.

origin_company_id.description: ID of the company that owns the upstream project. Null if there is no upstream company.

linked_local_rfis.description: Local RFIs linked to this external RFI.

cross_collab_originated.description: When `true`, this external RFI was created via cross-company collaboration export.

origin_rfi_url.description: URL to the originating RFI in the upstream project. Null if no origin RFI or URL is unavailable.

linked_drawings.description: Drawing attachments linked to this external RFI.
